author: David Bombal
description:
David speaks to Martin Lund, Vice President of Cisco’s Common Hardware Group, about the 3nm silicon chip inside the world's first 100Tbps switch. This multi-chip module delivers the raw 100Tbps throughput needed for gigawatt-scale clusters, powering massive training runs, inference, and real-time AI agents.
